existing_group_assignments.rationale: Induced Ang II accumulation describes increased angiotensin II, matching the existing increased Ang II events.
Mitochondrial dysfunction (placeholder title) is the same process as the general mitochondrial dysfunction event, differing in specificity.

new_groups.rationale: Both are expression changes of inner-ear development genes (six1b increased vs eya1 inhibited); related but different genes, flagged for review.
Reduced Ang II degradation and diminished Ang(1-7) concern the same angiotensin pathway but are distinct processes.
